newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil BNDES give CVRD staff loan to buy shares.
newsitem.headline: Brazil BNDES give CVRD staff loan to buy shares.

text.p: Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) is granting the employee's of privatized mining giant CVRD a loan of 201 million reais ($187.9 million) to buy the shares allocated to them under the privatization rules, a BNDES spokeswoman said.

She said Investvale, the investment club of CVRD employees, was receiving a loan to be paid back over 12 years and with the first instalment only due in three years time covering the total value of the employee share offer.

Investvale is due to buy Friday the 4.45 percent of CVRD ordinary shares and the 6.31 percent of preference stock set aside for staff at a price of 11.09 reais ($10.36) and 8.88 reais ($8.30) per share, respectively.
The CVRD employee share sale is the second step in the privatization of the world's largest iron ore producer and exporter which kicked off with the sale of a controling stake in CVRD May 6.
The Valepar consortium led by Brazilian steelmaker CSN bought 41.73 percent of CVRD voting shares for $3.15 billion.
Later this year, the remainder of the government's 51-percent stake in CVRD will be sold off in a global offer.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
